shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/pages/**' | head -200 && printf '\\nNext docs candidates:\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg -i 'cache|component|route|fetch' | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- Cache Components docs ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- migration guide ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- use cache docs ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' | sort && printf '\\n--- nested instructions ---\\n' && find app components -name AGENTS.md -print 2>/dev/null || true && printf '\\n--- imports/references ---\\n' && rg -n \"RequestMetadata|request|sampling|navigation|Suspense|headers\\(|cookies\\(|Math\\.random|Date\\(|crypto\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' . && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- cache migration key sections ---\\n' && rg -n \"Suspense|dynamic|request-time|uncached|prerender|navigation|static shell|Route.*opt|not.*prerender\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- request metadata ---' && cat components/request-metadata.tsx && printf '\\n--- migration guide ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- fetch data: streaming / suspense ---\\n' && sed -n '105,235p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && printf '\\n--- use-cache runtime restrictions ---\\n' && sed -n '225,285p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- package / tsconfig ---\\n' && cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- root listing ---\\n' && ls -la"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- non-deterministic APIs in docs ---' && rg -n -C 4 \"Math\\.random|randomUUID|Date\\.now|new Date|non-deterministic|runtime data|runtime APIs|request time|Suspense\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started -g '*.md' | head -240 && printf '\\n--- opt-out guidance ---\\n' && sed -n '75,145p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- eval files ---\\n' && rg --files __agent_eval__ && for f in __agent_eval__/*; do echo \"--- "'$f ---"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -c "rg -n -C 3 \"Math\\.random|randomUUID|Date\\.now|new Date\\(\\)|non-deterministic APIs|non-deterministic\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -g '*.md' | head -180; printf '\\n--- routes/cache components exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"experimental_ppr|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=|cacheComponents\" app components next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '315,395p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && printf '\\n--- connection function docs ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions | rg '/connection\\.md"'$'"' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md && printf '\\n--- route opts section ---\\n' && sed -n '65,112p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: next.config.ts @@ -const nextConfig: NextConfig = {} +const nextConfig: NextConfig = { + cacheComponents: true, +} *** Update File: app/layout.tsx @@ import type { ReactNode } from 'react' +import { Suspense } from 'react' import { RequestMetadata } from '@/components/request-metadata' @@ -
Operations
- +
+ Operations +
+ Preparing request metadata…}> + + {children} *** Update File: components/request-metadata.tsx @@ import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto' +import { connection } from 'next/server' -export function RequestMetadata() { +export async function RequestMetadata() { + await connection() + const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString() *** End Patch PATCH npm run build"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- tracked base tsconfig ---\\n' && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c "cat .gitignore && printf '\\n--- generated files ---\\n' && ls -ld .next next-env.d.ts && printf '\\n--- status including ignored summary ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c 'first=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | rg -o '"'Request ["'^<]+'"' | head -1); sleep 1; second="'$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | rg -o '"'Request ["'^<]+'"' | head -1); printf 'first:  %s\\nsecond: %s\\n' \""'$first" "$second"; test -n "$first" && test -n "$second" && test "$first" != "$second"'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .gitignore
@@
 node_modules/
 __agent_eval__/
+/.next/
+next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH
printf '\\n--- final source references ---\\n'
nl -ba next.config.ts
nl -ba app/layout.tsx
nl -ba components/request-metadata.tsx
printf '\\n--- route opt-outs ---\\n'
rg -n \"instant\\s*=\\s*false|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=\" app components next.config.ts || true
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short"
